groups.saying_opens: كان إذا كانت ليلة باردة أو مطيرة

notes: Saying 1 is Ibn Umar's act («أن ابن عمر ... نزل بضجنان ... فأمر المنادي»): his action is described, so he is not a link (rule 6) and the chain ends at نافع
Saying 2 is the Prophet's practice, introduced by «قال أيوب وحدثنا نافع عن ابن عمر»: a second saying with its own transmitters (rule 4a), ending at ابن عمر who relays it
Each group is labelled with its saying, so the shared tail is null
